text.en:
Section 8 of Batas Pambansa Blg. 20 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 8. Convening of the Sangguniang Pampook. The Sangguniang Pampook shall initially convene upon
call the President (Prime Minister) on such a date as he may deem proper and expedient."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-nine.
